cases.title: OAuth consent grant — privileged account compromise
cases.description:
## Summary

**Defender XDR** raised [`AL-9119`](/alerts?ref=AL-9119) after an unverified
multi-tenant application was granted `Mail.ReadWrite` and `offline_access` by
**three privileged users** inside an 11-minute window. The consent grants
followed a credential-phish lure referencing a fake billing portal, and one
service mailbox shows suspicious inbox-rule creation immediately after consent.

> **Working theory:** attacker-in-the-middle phishing harvested a session, then
> used repeated consent prompts to establish persistent, MFA-independent mailbox
> access. Treat as an active identity compromise until scoped.

## Affected accounts

| User | Role | Scopes granted | Mailbox rule? |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: |
| `priya.nadar@example.com` | Finance Director | `Mail.ReadWrite`, `offline_access` | ✅ |
| `daniel.okoro@example.com` | AP Manager | `Mail.ReadWrite`, `offline_access` | — |
| `svc-billing@example.com` | Service (shared) | `Mail.ReadWrite`, `offline_access` | ✅ |

## Indicators

```text
App (client) ID   9f4c2a17-8b3e-4d21-a0c9-6e5f1b7d3a44
App display name  "Billing Insights Connector" (unverified publisher)
Reply URL         https://billing-insights[.]app/oauth/callback
Consent source IP 45.129.14.62 (AS9009, RO)
```

## Containment checklist

- [x] Revoke active refresh tokens for all three accounts
- [x] Force password reset + re-registration of phishing-resistant MFA
- [ ] Disable / block the app registration tenant-wide
- [ ] Remove attacker-created inbox rules and audit forwarding
- [ ] Hunt for the same `client_id` across all connected tenants

## References

- MITRE ATT&CK — [T1528: Steal Application Access Token](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1528/)
- MITRE ATT&CK — [T1114.002: Remote Email Collection](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1114/002/)
- Internal runbook — [BEC investigation guide](/knowledge-base)
cases.summary: Containment is underway; tokens have been revoked for the affected accounts.

comments.message: @analyst audit logs show consent grants preceded by the billing lure for 2 of 3 users.
Tokens revoked and credentials reset. Escalating severity to High while app block is pending.

cases.title: Ransomware precursor activity — lateral movement detected
cases.description:
## Summary

**CrowdStrike** detected suspicious `PsExec` usage from **SRV-APP01** to multiple
workstations in the Finance VLAN, with command-and-control callbacks to
`45.155.205.233`. Based on the observed TTPs and dwell-time analysis, ransomware
deployment appears **imminent**.

> ⚠️ **Escalation:** IR retainer activated. Affected VLANs isolated. Do **not**
> power off hosts — capture volatile memory before imaging.

## Affected assets

| Host | Role | VLAN / Subnet | State |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SRV-APP01` | Application server (patient zero) | `10.23.1.0/24` | Contained |
| `WKS-2210` | Finance workstation | `10.23.4.0/24` | Contained |
| `WKS-2214` | Finance workstation | `10.23.4.0/24` | Monitoring |
| `FILESRV-AU02` | File server | `10.23.1.0/24` | At risk |

## Indicators of compromise

| Type | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IPv4 (C2) | `45.155.205.233` | Blocklisted at perimeter |
| Domain | `update-svc[.]cloud` | Resolves to C2 |
| Tool | `PsExec.exe` | Renamed `p64.exe` in `C:\PerfLogs\` |
| File ext | `.0rgn` | Appended on mass-rename attempts |

## ATT&CK coverage

1. **Initial Access** — T1566 Phishing
2. **Lateral Movement** — [T1570 Lateral Tool Transfer](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1570/)
3. **Impact** — [T1486 Data Encrypted for Impact](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1486/)

## Response tasks

- [x] Network-contain SRV-APP01 and callback endpoints
- [x] Block `45.155.205.233` + associated domains at the firewall
- [ ] Capture RAM + full-disk images from SRV-APP01
- [ ] Confirm backups are clean, offline, and restorable
- [ ] Identify ransomware family from staged binaries
cases.summary: Isolated affected VLANs. IR retainers activated. Awaiting disk images from SRV-APP01.

SHA256 of PsExec binary dropped on SRV-APP01

cases.title: Data exfiltration via unapproved SaaS application
cases.description:
## Summary

The **Netskope CASB** alerted on an unusually large data transfer from OneDrive
to an unapproved third-party file-sharing service, `tempfileshare[.]io`.
Approximately **4.2 GB** of files carrying `PII` and `Financial` sensitivity
labels were moved over a 45-minute window from an **unmanaged device**.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| User | `marcus.johnson@example.com` |
| Source | OneDrive for Business |
| Destination | `tempfileshare[.]io` (unmanaged) |
| Volume | ~4.2 GB (≈ 1,180 files) |
| Window | 45 minutes |
| Device | Unmanaged / non-compliant |

## Data at risk

- **PII** — employee records, contact details
- **Financial** — draft quarterly statements, vendor banking details
- Unknown quantity of documents pending DLP classification

## Regulatory considerations

> Legal has been notified. If personal data of EU/UK data subjects is confirmed,
> a **72-hour GDPR breach-notification clock** may apply from the point of
> awareness — track the decision in the case timeline.

## Response tasks

- [x] Disable `marcus.johnson@example.com` and revoke all sessions/tokens
- [ ] Review OneDrive audit, CASB, and endpoint DLP events for full scope
- [ ] Request takedown + access logs from `tempfileshare[.]io`
- [ ] Draft data-subject notification with Legal (if in scope)

## References

- MITRE ATT&CK — [T1567.002: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1567/002/)
cases.summary: User account disabled pending investigation. Legal notified for potential regulatory reporting.

comments.message: User account disabled. Confirmed 4.2 GB of data transferred. Legal team notified.
